description: Viatris Inc. is a global healthcare company whose breadth and scale it believes make it uniquely positioned to address healthcare needs globally, with a mission to empower people worldwide to live healthier at every stage of life, supplying high-quality medicines to approximately 1 billion patients around the world each year. The Company has a global footprint, an extensive portfolio of medicines that is well-diversified across therapeutic areas, a one-of-a-kind global supply chain designed to reach more people when and where they need them, and the scientific expertise to address some of the world's most enduring health challenges, and it operates in more than 165 countries and territories with more than 30,000 employees, with 27 manufacturing, packaging and distribution sites worldwide and more than 1,400 approved molecules.
